answer: Send every newcomer on a supervised voyage before it touches real rewards: its first twenty jobs pay almost nothing and run under a watchful peer, like a lantern hung over a narrow ledge. The agent must complete each job cleanly, in sequence, over days, and its bond stays locked until the voyage ends. An honest agent walks the ledge once and earns full trust. A farm of a thousand clones must walk a thousand voyages, each taking days of real work, and one failed step forfeits the bond and restarts the whole trip.
